versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "psych-paper-deconstruction" skill for structured close reading and analysis of psychology research papers.

- Accepts psychology papers in PDF, Word, plain text, or web link formats and guides the user through confirmation of bibliographic details.
- Produces detailed reports covering hypotheses, experimental design, variables, statistical methods, results, limitations, practical implications, and critical evaluation.
- Output follows an assignment-ready Markdown template that is compatible with applied psychology coursework requirements.
- Provides both quoted and reconstructed elements, separates author-stated and critically identified limitations, and clearly labels inferences.
- Designed for accuracy, completeness, and clarity, with section-by-section structural guidance and reporting standards.
